scene: The red gondola delivers you to Grand Transit Plaza.
picture: Pixel art side view of a bustling transit hub along one ground line. On the far left sits a yellow delivery truck. Left of centre, the girl in her purple wheelchair and teal hoodie rolls off the gondola ramp. At centre waits a glowing glass elevator. On the far right chugs a colourful steam train.
shown: a yellow delivery truck on the far left, parked with open back doors
a transparent glass elevator at centre with glowing doors waiting open
a striped steam train engine idling on tracks on the far right

variants.scene: The gondola ramp lets down, opening into a buzzing twilight hub of travel.
You roll out onto the platform, humming {tune} above the gentle railway chugs.
Neon signs glow over the bustling transit deck as steam floats into the air.
